findings.detail: The income identity must use net expenses after the 16,926 management-fee waiver and subtract 5 of income taxes; the filing then ties exactly.

rationale: Raw statement-of-operations rows show total investment income of 217,498, gross total expenses of 90,650, a 16,926 management-fee waiver, net expenses of 73,724, and income taxes of 5. The authoritative filing identity is 217,498 - 73,724 - 5 = 143,769, exactly the reported net investment income. A check using gross expenses would omit the waiver and create a spurious failure, so the flag is a rule-scope false alarm rather than a source-data error.
